title: +TRANSITIONS
description: Supports students beginning their Oregon State journey by introducing them to the university’s mission and goals, sharing the tools and resources it offers its students, and assisting students in developing strategies for their personal and academic success and well-being.
registration_restrictions: Enrollment limited to students in the Oregon State - Corvallis campus.
